decisive_items: brown, multilobular lesions confined to the deep corneal stroma
central infiltrate involving all corneal layers and a peripheral infiltrate concentrated in the deep stroma
response.rationale: The presence of brown, multilobular lesions in the deep corneal stroma and the findings on anterior segment optical coherence tomography are more suggestive of fungal keratitis than other options.

rejected.why: Previous infection had resolved before DSAEK surgery.
Immune-mediated response is possible but less specific.
Steroid-induced keratitis is a possibility but the description of lesions is more indicative of an infectious process.
Bacterial keratitis could be considered but the specific findings are more consistent with fungal keratitis.
